description: My team aims to build a website which helps combine data from MODIS and VIIRS to help people who really need it. I hope everyone has fun in the hackathon!!!
summary: My group has developed a website which has combined data collected from MODIS and VIIRS. Since MODIS is ending operations around 2026-2027, the website we made will help store the data for future generations. Now, with this website people can study the trends of hotspots around the world and find clever solutions to tackle them.
details:
My website shows the number of hotspot in the entire world each day. Users can choose any day about these hotspots. It helps preserve data collected by these satellites and provide analytics for people who want to research them. I use VS code and Vercel to build this website.

Warning: The data collected is from a short period of time only.
